inlines.v: MEM'BRANE, noun [Latin membrana.] In anatomy, a thin, white, flexible skin, formed by fibers interwoven like net-work, and serving to cover some part of the body. The term is applied to the thin expanded parts, of various texture, both in animals and vegetables.
